description:
You are managing the finances for GAEC JOULIN, a farm in Charente-Maritime, France. The grain cooperative 'Coopérative Agricole de Charente' has sent a check for €8,750.00 to pay for a recent wheat delivery.

Your task is to record this incoming payment in Ekylibre:

1. Navigate to the incoming payments section (you should already be on or near this page)
2. Create a new incoming payment with these details:
   - Payer: Coopérative Agricole de Charente (search for this entity in the payer field)
   - Amount: 8750.00
   - Payment mode: Select any available payment mode from the dropdown (check or bank transfer)
   - Paid on (date): 2024-09-15
   - Bank check number / Reference: CHQ-4721-2024
3. Save the payment record

The customer entity 'Coopérative Agricole de Charente' already exists in the system.

Login credentials if needed: admin@ekylibre.org / 12345678
Ekylibre URL: http://demo.ekylibre.farm:3000
